request.description:
Tick tda's acceptance [1] puts the glm and claude configs in .tick/runners.cloud.toml, but a worker may not write that file, and attempt 2 was refused whole for doing it. The block is internal/runconfig/testdata/runners.cloud.configs.toml, and two repository guards check it against the real files. Until it is appended, a cloud run of an epic labelled config: claude is refused, because the cloud files declare no named configs. Fix: sed -n '/^# Named run configs/,$p' internal/runconfig/testdata/runners.cloud.configs.toml >> .tick/runners.cloud.toml. The guards then hold the real file. This must be done by the operator or the run, not a worker.
evidence: internal/runconfig/testdata/runners.cloud.configs.toml; internal/reconcile/runconfig_select.go selectRunConfig (a label on a cloud run without configs is refused)

ticfac run epic-v5t created this tick by absorbing the finding 1438f03bddefb40102b41cd1183eb6ba63f3a9936d35cf634d496b4598cf2880 (reported by run-epic-v5t/tick-tda/attempt-3): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1, as its reporter asserts at high severity. The decision record — item id, verdict, basis — is .ticfac/runs/epic-v5t/absorptions/1438f03bddefb40102b41cd1183eb6ba63f3a9936d35cf634d496b4598cf2880.json on the run branch.
request.title: Append the two named cloud configs to .tick/runners.cloud.toml
